title: Canary promotion hysteresis and shadow->canary safety checklist
creator: Marco Ruiz
description:
Summary: After a recent staged promotion from shadow to canary for model v3.1, we observed a transient divergence in outputs and latency spikes for a subset of traffic that correlated with cross-region surge events and KV-cache key eviction patterns. This ticket captures the incident follow-up work: a safety checklist for shadow->canary promotions, hysteresis tuning for auto-rollback, synthetic canary augmentation, and a lightweight runbook to reduce MTTR for future promotions.

Root cause hypothesis: the promotion path promoted a model variant that had slightly different sequence-length distribution and cache key namespaces. Under a traffic surge from EU->US failover, the runtime's KV cache eviction policy collided with A/B traffic partitions, causing increased cache misses and upstream latency that triggered error-budget alarms; the auto-rollback hysteresis thresholds were too aggressive and executed multiple short rollbacks, amplifying instability.

Goals: (1) codify a pre-promotion checklist that includes cache-keyspace validation and region-specific synthetic spikes; (2) implement hysteresis tuning for auto-rollback that incorporates customer-tier SLOs and traffic momentum; (3) add a short synthetic canary step that runs canonical prompts under production routing conditions; (4) update runbook with clear rollback vs. hold decisions and an immediate mitigation play if KV-cache collision is suspected.

Why this differs from prior work: several prior tickets focused on generic rollback automation and canary safety. This ticket is specifically about the shadow-to-canary promotion path, hysteresis that is sensitive to cross-region surges, and a minimal-onramp synthetic step to catch stateful cache interactions prior to broad rollout.

Artifacts: Confluence doc with experiments and suggested thresholds: https://confluence.redwood.internal/display/RUN/ENG-412908-safety-checklist. Post-incident dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/rollouts/canary-412908. GitHub PR with hysteresis algorithm: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1289. Synthetic canary harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/testing/tree/main/synthetic-canary
comments: 2026-03-10 - Marco Ruiz: Initial investigation summary and hypothesis posted. Linked latency spikes to regional failover windows and KV cache churn. Opened ticket to capture follow-ups.
2026-03-11 - Aisha Patel: Reproduced increased 95p latency in staging by replaying EU->US surge using load harness. Observed KV cache miss rate jump ~4x for canary bucket during promotion sequence.

2026-03-12 - SRE review by Priya Singh: Suggested adding a short (5 minute) synthetic validation in the promotion pipeline that runs against production routing (no synthetic traffic tagging) to detect stateful regressions before increasing traffic split.

2026-03-13 - Security review by Omar Benali: No sensitive data exposure risk identified in synthetic harness as long as synthetic prompts are canonicalized; recommended add KMS audit entry point to the runbook.

2026-03-14 - Aisha Patel: Drafted hysteresis algorithm PR and noted two trade-offs: (a) longer hysteresis reduces false rollbacks but increases exposure time for a bad model; (b) making hysteresis SLO-aware requires per-customer tier mapping and will add config surface. Open PR: runtime#1289 for review.
acceptance_criteria: Pre-promotion safety checklist published in Confluence and linked from the console promotion flow
Hysteresis algorithm merged and deployed to staging with configurable thresholds per release and per-customer tier
Synthetic canary step implemented in promotion pipeline and runs in staging against production routing for at least two full traffic-window simulations
Runbook updated with step-by-step mitigation for suspected KV-cache collisions and a clear decision matrix for rollback vs hold
Post-deployment dashboard panels added: canary 95p latency, cache miss delta vs baseline, model output divergence score; alert thresholds documented

Add synthetic canary configuration to promotion pipeline: 5m validation, canonical prompts, and cache-warm hooks - owner: Testing team
Update Console promotion UI to surface the pre-promotion checklist and a quick 'run synthetic canary' button - owner: Console UX
Run three scheduled cross-region surge simulations in staging and capture telemetry - owner: SRE
Schedule post-deploy readout with PM, SRE, and Observability to lock in thresholds - due by 2026-03-20
